title: US Federal Register Documents 2024-2026
subtitle: 76,223 rules, proposed rules, notices and executive orders, Jan 2024-Oct 2026
description:
Every document published in the US Federal Register from 1 January 2024 to 31 October 2026: 76,223 final rules, proposed rules, agency notices and presidential documents (executive orders, proclamations, memoranda), one row each. Pulled from the official Federal Register API on 2026-11-15. Real data, not generated.

The window spans the last year of the Biden administration and the first 21 months of the second Trump administration, so it captures a change of government in the regulatory record: the January 2025 regulatory freeze, the surge of executive orders, fewer final rules, and the October-November 2025 government shutdown, when the number of documents published fell by three quarters.

Each row has the title, the agency's abstract, the action line, issuing agencies, the OIRA "significant" designation (EO 12866), page count, effective date, comment deadline and comment period length, CFR titles and topics amended, docket and RIN counts, executive order numbers and signing dates, and page views on federalregister.gov.

Good for: text classification (predict the agency, document type or significance from the abstract), regulatory time series, comparing administrations, comment-period and effective-date analysis, and topic modelling. About 7,000 rules and proposed rules carry a significance label (roughly 18% significant), a ready-made imbalanced classification target; the starter notebook trains a TF-IDF baseline on it.

Source: Federal Register API (https://www.federalregister.gov/developers/documentation/api/v1), published by the Office of the Federal Register (NARA) and the Government Publishing Office. Federal Register content is a work of the US government and is not subject to copyright in the United States, so this compilation is released under CC0. This is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register. page_views and significant can change after the snapshot date. The collection script is included so the snapshot can be repeated or extended.

resources.description: One row per Federal Register document published 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-31, sorted by publication date (snapshot 2026-11-15)

fields.name: document_number
fields.title: Document number
fields.description: Federal Register document number, unique key; the page is https://www.federalregister.gov/d/<document_number>

fields.name: publication_date
fields.title: Publication date
fields.description: Date the document was published in the Federal Register

fields.name: type
fields.title: Type
fields.description: Rule, Proposed Rule, Notice or Presidential Document

fields.name: subtype
fields.title: Subtype
fields.description: For presidential documents: Executive Order, Proclamation, Memorandum, Determination, Notice, etc. Blank otherwise

fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Document title

fields.name: abstract
fields.title: Abstract
fields.description: Summary written by the issuing agency (blank for about 28% of documents, mostly notices and presidential documents)

fields.name: action
fields.title: Action
fields.description: Short action line, e.g. 'Final rule.', 'Notice of proposed rulemaking.'

fields.name: agency
fields.title: Agency
fields.description: Top-level issuing department or independent agency (the parent when a sub-agency is listed)

fields.name: agencies
fields.title: Agencies
fields.description: All agencies named on the document, pipe-separated

fields.name: n_agencies
fields.title: N agencies
fields.description: Number of agencies named

fields.name: significant
fields.title: Significant
fields.description: True when OIRA designated the rule significant under Executive Order 12866; blank when not reported (all notices, about half of rules)

fields.name: page_length
fields.title: Page length
fields.description: Printed pages in the Federal Register

fields.name: effective_on
fields.title: Effective on
fields.description: Date a rule takes effect, when stated

fields.name: days_to_effective
fields.title: Days to effective
fields.description: effective_on minus publication_date, in days

fields.name: comments_close_on
fields.title: Comments close on
fields.description: Public comment deadline, when the document invites comments

fields.name: comment_period_days
fields.title: Comment period days
fields.description: comments_close_on minus publication_date, in days

fields.name: topics
fields.title: Topics
fields.description: CFR index topics assigned to the document, pipe-separated

fields.name: n_topics
fields.title: N topics
fields.description: Number of CFR index topics

fields.name: cfr_titles
fields.title: Cfr titles
fields.description: Code of Federal Regulations titles the document amends (e.g. 40 = Protection of Environment), pipe-separated

fields.name: n_cfr_references
fields.title: N cfr references
fields.description: Number of CFR title/part references

fields.name: n_dockets
fields.title: N dockets
fields.description: Number of docket identifiers

fields.name: regulation_id_numbers
fields.title: Regulation id numbers
fields.description: Regulation Identifier Numbers (RINs) linking to the Unified Agenda, pipe-separated

fields.name: president
fields.title: President
fields.description: President in office on the publication date

fields.name: executive_order_number
fields.title: Executive order number
fields.description: Executive order number, for executive orders only

fields.name: signing_date
fields.title: Signing date
fields.description: Date a presidential document was signed

fields.name: is_correction
fields.title: Is correction
fields.description: True when the document corrects an earlier one

fields.name: page_views
fields.title: Page views
fields.description: Page views on federalregister.gov as of the snapshot (2026-11-15); older documents have had longer to accumulate them

sources: Federal Register API v1, documents endpoint (www.federalregister.gov/api/v1), Office of the Federal Register / NARA
provenance.collection_methodology: One query per calendar month with per_page=1000, following the API's cursor until every document the API reports for that month is collected (the script fails if the counts differ). Nested fields are flattened and a few durations derived. See fetch_dataset.py.
